claims.text: Stated inference, and it is the strand's comparison. The board already records that this DIRD is attributed on the DIA list supplied to the Senate Armed Services Committee to 'Dr S Macheret, Lockheed Martin'. A government agency paid a Lockheed Martin plasma physicist to survey magnetohydrodynamic propulsion under the same programme the lore invokes, and what he delivered concerns scramjet inlets, virtual cowls and reentry drag reduction. NOTHING JOINS THIS DOCUMENT TO US 3,322,374 and the edge between them records a similarity of subject only.

claims.text: A PATENT IS TIER 1 FOR WHAT IT CLAIMS AND IS NEVER EVIDENCE THAT THE THING WORKS. What US 3,322,374 claims is magnetohydrodynamic propulsion: coils along the craft's axis driven by polyphase alternating current produce a travelling point of maximum magnetic flux density running from the leading to the trailing end, which induces eddy currents in the surrounding ionised fluid and drives that fluid backwards. The patent is a linear induction motor using the atmosphere as its armature.

claims.sourceText: Reasoning over the OSTI abstract for the YAMATO-1 paper against the opened text of US 3,322,374, https://www.osti.gov/biblio/135352 , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: Stated inference, and it is short. The propulsion mechanism US 3,322,374 claims is magnetohydrodynamic, and magnetohydrodynamic propulsion was demonstrated at sea by a civil foundation in June 1992, in public, under a named chairman, with the results reported at an international conference. THE INFERENCE IS THAT THE MECHANISM DOES NOT REQUIRE A SECRET TO EXIST and nothing more. It is not an argument about what was or was not recovered, and no edge from this node asserts one.

Word counts across all seven pages: scalar 0, spin 0, gravity 0, anti-gravity 0, zero point 0. NOBODY DENIED ANYTHING HERE: a real, openable, mundane document simply does not say what was said of it, which is why the verdict is association and not directed.

edges.label: In the strand because of what was claimed for it, not because of what is in it
edges.note: THE PATENT ITSELF IS NOT EXOTIC. It is a linear induction motor using ionised air as its armature, which is classical electromagnetism. It sits in this domain solely because it was cited as evidence for scalar physics, and the strand's product is the gap between the citation and the document.
